text: あっちこっちで　つり　まくって　くれい！

structure.jp: つり　まくって　くれい！

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる added to a verb means doing it wildly, over and over. つり　まくる = 'fish like crazy'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-verb is a blunt 'do it for me'. The added い is an old-man touch that makes it sound hearty. つり　まくって　くれい = 'go fish like crazy!'
